scope: Resource-only repair for candidate-3 synthetic 4x16 after two cgroup OOMs before any durable micro-gradient marker.
advance_rule: Advance from 32G to 40G only if the current attempt is killed by the host cgroup OOM mechanism before a durable MICRO_GRADIENT_STARTED marker is written, with optimizer_update=false and no dataset/outcome access.
hard_stop_rule: Once any durable micro-gradient marker is written, do not increase host-memory ceiling in response to subsequent failure. Any later GPU/host resource failure is candidate evidence and must be adjudicated before practical-batch fallback.
